title: AION 2 Maintenance: Schedule and Server Status
description: See AION 2 Global maintenance times, the October 5 launch window and fixes for login, access and account errors.
summary: Plan around Global maintenance and use the client error to find the right login fix.
quickAnswer: Global maintenance is scheduled for October 5, 2026, 05:00–13:00 UTC, with public access at 13:00 UTC. Check the latest announcement for schedule changes.

toc.title: Check the status relevant to your login

workflow.title: Diagnose a failed login
workflow.caption: Use the latest official notice and the exact client message to choose the next action.

steps.label: Read the latest notice
steps.description: Check the announcement date, region, scope, and whether a completion update has been posted.

steps.label: Compare the time window
steps.description: Convert the stated timezone to your local time and check the latest end time.

steps.label: Check client and identity
steps.description: If the message concerns access or an account, restart/update the client and verify the playing login identity.

steps.label: Report the remaining error
steps.description: Keep the exact error, launcher, region, and attempt time for official support.
